_about: Engine-side behaviour of MSCI commands found by reading C702.__runScript (x3story.obj AP 3.3 addon/04.cat, FL addon2/06.cat of 2026-11-06). 'games' lists where the note holds; S-numbers refer to kc/script_bugs.md of the reverse engineering project. Checked from the code, not in the game. Read by `x3kc msci ref`.

1063.note: Answer inverted: returns GetNoFind() != 0, and NoFind means 'excluded from searches'. Use `not` on the result, or another test.

1064.note: The result goes into the type slot: the variable gets type 0/1 and value 0, so it reads as 0/null. Do not rely on it.

1065.note: Same bug as 1064: the formation number lands in the type slot, the value is 0.

1359.note: With a wing given by number (not a wing object) the check runs on the found wing but AddShip on the number: the ship is not added. Pass a wing object.

1489.note: Opens only when the client state is exactly 0 (`!state & 1`); with any client flag set the script gets the default answer at once. Fixed in FL.

1537.note: Same as 1489: with any client flag set no dialog opens, the default answer comes back. Fixed in FL.

1174.note: The handler reads its cells shifted by one (as if it had a result): the ware gets the type code of the number and the amount 0. The command does not do what its text says.

2478.note: The second parameter is read from the cells of the first: both values are the first argument.

2479.note: The second parameter is read from the cells of the first.

2480.note: The second parameter is read from the cells of the first.

3046.note: SetLaserGroup(a, a): the second number is a copy of the first.

3238.note: AddFaceID(id, id, flag) instead of (id, flag, race); the paired 3239 is right.

2612.note: The result cell is not read: no result is stored and `if`/`skip if` on the command do nothing; the number is read one cell late.

2969.note: The result cell is not read: IsCommandRunning() is lost, `if`/`skip if` on the command do nothing.

3241.note: The result is never stored and the parameters are read one cell early: GetFaceFromID gets type codes.

2388.note: Signature and handler swapped with 2389: the handler is the getter IsMarineTrainingBoard() and writes into the variable whose index is the type cell.

2389.note: Signature and handler swapped with 2388: the handler is the setter SetMarineTrainingBoard and takes its value from past the end of the line.

2482.note: The signature says 'result + bool', the handler is the setter SetRebuild(bool) and takes the object from the result cell.

3196.note: The handler reads a race (cells 2-3) the signature does not have: it gets whatever follows the line.

1931.note: The last parameter is not read.

2163.note: Only 4 of the 8 numbers reach the boarding table; the last 4 are ignored.
